security.resolution: The gate now scans the API and web images as well as the database image. The API runtime stage dropped pip, whose vendored msgpack and setuptools code carried the listed findings, and the uv binary. Stock Caddy failed the gate (2.10 with 83 fixable high or critical findings, 2.11.4 with 17 in its Go toolchain and modules), so the web image builds Caddy 2.11.4 with Go 1.26.6 and fixed x/crypto, x/net, x/text, and gRPC versions.

scale.catalog_full_measurement_note: Two scale runs of this tree failed this gate, at 792.6 ms and 860.4 ms against 750 ms, on a loaded host: the first as the security gate's image builds finished, the second during an unrelated archive extraction. The run after both had ended measured 399.8 ms. The gate was not changed.

canvas.reason: On the 0.3.0 production build the idle browser frame baseline dropped frames on the measurement host in every run, with intervals up to 183.6 ms; in one run it fell to 15 frames per second while idle against 60 while drawing. Every run was marked not valid and none of its timings is evidence.
